scenes.title: 아홉 번째 열쇠
scenes.summary: Saturday morning at the front desk: Hannah, Graham, and Arthur open the dusty cedar box stamped 'Room 9' with the small brass key.

scenes.title: 책을 옮기다
scenes.summary: Tessa joins Hannah and Graham in the back hallway to unload the heavy wooden bookcase and uncover a narrow painted door.

scenes.title: 유리와 먼지
scenes.summary: Hannah, Tessa, and Arthur step into Room 9—a forgotten glass garden sunroom overlooking the side of the courtyard.

scenes.title: 하얀 천 아래에
scenes.summary: Guest and retired piano teacher Evelyn helps Hannah and Graham pull back the white cloth, revealing an old wooden upright piano.

scenes.title: 선룸 치수 재기
scenes.summary: Acoustic architect Caleb and his older brother Owen inspect the sunroom walls with Hannah and confirm the room has wonderful natural sound.

scenes.title: 오월의 우편엽서
scenes.summary: Over mid-morning tea, Tessa, Evelyn, and Graham read the old postcards from the cedar box and learn Room 9 once hosted Friday tea concerts.

scenes.title: 동전 세어 보기
scenes.summary: Arthur worries about the cost of renovating Room 9 until Hannah and Tessa show him a simple low-cost budget.

scenes.title: 그 스위치는 만지지 마세요
scenes.summary: Arthur eagerly flips the old brass wall switch in Room 9 before Graham can check the wires, blowing the first-floor fuse.
